messages:
maya-fin: Quick sync 16: we need approvals to run a week-long pricing-matrix pilot targeting mid-tier customers. Goal: test tiered per-token + monthly floor for churn impact and revenue recognition. Need sign-off from billing, legal, and sales ops.

emma-prod: Summary: Pilot size ~200 accounts, split into 3 arms (control, tiered, tiered+floor). Expected short-term revenue lift ~+$8k/mo, revenue-recognition complexity minimal because we won't change contract terms for annual customers.

sam-billing: Two questions: (1) how do we tag pilot invoices in billing system so GL lines are separable? (2) Are we doing preview-only first or going straight to billed pilot?

nina-legal: For annual customers we must not alter charged price without consent. If you plan to charge a floor we need a consent path or exclude annuals. Also need to review customer notice language. I'll need the cohort export with contract_type and renewal_date.

ara-salesops: Exclude any accounts with active sales discounts or pending credits. Also request a whitelist so AMs can opt-in their customers manually.

june-cs: If we do billed pilot we need a CS playbook for handling upset customers and a canned escalation tag. I'll prepare the template but need the exact phrasing first. Avoid words like "rate hike".

ezane-eng: I'll add runtime gating. Proposed flag: ff:pricing-matrix-pilot-v1. It supports arms: control|tiered|tiered_floor and a metadata tag pilot_id. ETA: 2 days. We should run preview sandbox for 48h first.

sam-billing: For GL tagging I'll add invoice_meta.pilot_code and a separate revenue_account mapping so finance can split reports. For preview-only mode I can surface invoice previews to CS without emitting charge events. We'll need a flag preview=true.

maya-fin: Good. Finance requirement: invoices from pilot should be split into a reporting bucket so we can calculate net uplift and delta churn by arm. Also capture last_6mo_growth and support_tier in export.

nina-legal: One more legal ask: if floor charges cause a negative proration edge case for pro-rated mid-cycle credits, we must route those through manual adjustments and not auto-apply. Add a rule: auto-prorate=false for pilot.

ara-salesops: On opt-in: please add am_owned boolean column so AMs can approve. We'll only include AM-approved customers in the tiered_floor arm.

june-cs: Can we run a small dry-run with 10 accounts first? want to validate messaging and support load.

emma-prod: Yes small dry-run first: 10 accounts (5 tiered, 5 tiered_floor) for 72h preview. If no disputes >1 and billing reconciliation OK, escalate to full 200-account pilot.

sam-billing: I'll prepare the export with these columns: customer_id, am_owned, contract_type, renewal_date, last_6mo_growth, monthly_spend_est, support_tier, last_invoice_dispute_90d. Will also add invoice_meta.pilot_code on preview.

billing-bot: sandbox-preview created: pilot_code=pmatrix-2026-04, mode=preview-sandbox, users=10, created_by=maya-fin

ezane-eng: Sandbox flag live in staging. I've wired preview=false|true and pilot_id metadata to billing svc.

maya-fin: Timeline: export by sam today -> legal review by nina tomorrow -> eng flag by Thu -> 72h dry-run Fri-Mon (preview) -> finance reconciliation -> decide on expanded pilot next Tue.

emma-prod: Communication plan: CS dry-run notice -> AM opt-in window -> preview toggle -> 72h monitor -> finance + data to run uplift + churn analysis. I'll draft the AM opt-in digest and post for sign-off.

june-cs: I'll prepare the playbook and standby rotations. Add escalation tag: #pilot-pmatrix.

ara-salesops: I'll circulate an AM opt-in spreadsheet and lock it 24h before preview.

sam-billing: Export in progress, will DM link and tag @nina-legal and @ara-salesops.

maya-fin: Thanks all. If anyone sees red flags (contracts, discounts, disputes) pull the emergency stop.

emma-prod: Appreciate it. Posting the AM opt-in draft in ~30m for review. :rocket:
